scenario: 推荐/风控系统里,预测目标依赖"朋友的朋友"这类 2–3 跳的关系上下文,单条记录的表格特征抓不到。
scenario_en: In a rec/risk system the target depends on 2-3 hop relational context (friend-of-friend) that per-row tabular features can't capture.
q: 什么时候该上 GNN,判据是什么?
q_en: When should you use a GNN, and by what test?
why: 当预测目标依赖多跳关系上下文、且这种结构信号能被证明比表格基线更好时才上 GNN。它靠逐层消息传递把邻居信息聚合进节点 embedding,但会带来构图、采样、训练、serving 的额外成本;若表格已抓住信号,GNN 只加成本不加收益。
why_en: Use a GNN only when the target depends on multi-hop relational context that demonstrably beats a tabular baseline, since it adds construction, sampling, training, and serving costs.
diagram:
flowchart LR
  N["目标节点"] --> A["聚合 1 跳邻居特征"]
  A --> B["再聚合 2 跳邻居"]
  B --> E["更新节点 embedding"]
options: 只要数据能画成图就该用 GNN,图结构永远比表格特征更强
只有多跳信号可证明优于表格基线时才用
任何推荐系统都必须上 GNN,否则抓不到用户的兴趣演化
GNN 只适合图像和文本,关系数据交给表格模型就够了
options_en: Use a GNN whenever data can be drawn as a graph; graph structure always beats tabular features.
Only when multi-hop signal demonstrably beats a tabular baseline.
Every recommender must adopt a GNN or it misses how user interest evolves.
GNNs only suit images and text; relational data is fine with tabular models.
whenOtherWins: 若表格特征(购买次数、时长等)已能达到目标质量,就别上 GNN——构图和多跳 serving 的成本换不来收益。
optionExplanations: 能画成图不等于图信号有用,盲目上 GNN 会白白背上构图和采样成本。
对;判据是"多跳信号可证明超过表格基线",这把 GNN 的额外成本和真实收益绑在一起。
很多推荐用表格/双塔就够,GNN 是有多跳结构收益时才加的手段,不是必需。
GNN 正是为关系/图数据设计的,说反了;图像文本反而用 CNN/transformer。
optionExplanations_en: Drawable as a graph doesn't mean the graph signal helps; blindly adopting a GNN just adds construction and sampling cost.
Correct — the test is that multi-hop signal provably beats a tabular baseline, tying the GNN's extra cost to real benefit.
Many recommenders are fine with tabular/two-tower; a GNN is added only when multi-hop structure pays off.
GNNs are built for relational/graph data — reversed; images and text use CNNs/transformers instead.

termDefinitions.meaning: 在图上逐层聚合邻居信息、学习节点 embedding 的神经网络。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A GNN (Graph Neural Network) learns node embeddings by aggregating neighbor information layer by layer on a graph.

termDefinitions.meaning: 沿边走 2–3 步能到达的邻居信息,如"朋友的朋友"或二度交易关系。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Multi-hop context is information reachable 2-3 edges away, like friend-of-friend or second-degree transaction links.

tradeoff: 多跳结构信号的增益 vs 构图/采样/serving 的额外成本

scenario: 面试官问所有 GNN 共有的计算范式是什么。
scenario_en: The interviewer asks what computation paradigm all GNNs share.
q: GNN 的"消息传递"每层在做什么?
q_en: What does GNN message passing do at each layer?
why: 每一层:节点收集它邻居的特征(消息)→按某种聚合函数(mean-pool/LSTM/注意力)汇总→用汇总结果更新自己的 embedding。堆 L 层就能把 L 跳内的关系信息压进节点表示。
why_en: At each layer a node gathers neighbor features, aggregates them (mean-pool/LSTM/attention), and updates its own embedding, so L layers capture L-hop context.
options: 把整张图压成一个全局向量,所有节点共享同一个 embedding
节点收集邻居特征→聚合→更新自身 embedding
对每个节点独立跑一个 MLP,完全不看邻居,只用自身特征
逐条边生成一段文本描述,再交给 LLM 阅读理解后打分
options_en: Compress the whole graph into one global vector that all nodes share.
A node gathers neighbor features, aggregates, and updates its own embedding.
Run an independent MLP per node using only its own features, ignoring neighbors.
Generate a text description per edge and have an LLM read and score it.
optionExplanations: GNN 给每个节点各自的 embedding,不是全图共享一个向量,那样就丢了节点差异。
对;收集邻居→聚合→更新是消息传递的三步,层数决定能看多少跳。
只用自身特征就退化成普通 MLP,恰恰没用到图结构,不是 GNN。
逐边转文本喂 LLM 不是 GNN 的机制,GNN 直接在向量上聚合邻居。
optionExplanations_en: A GNN gives each node its own embedding, not one shared vector, which would erase node differences.
Correct — gather neighbors, aggregate, update is the three-step message passing, and depth sets how many hops you see.
Using only self features degenerates to a plain MLP and ignores graph structure — not a GNN.
Edge-to-text into an LLM isn't the GNN mechanism; a GNN aggregates neighbors directly on vectors.

termDefinitions.meaning: GNN 的核心计算:节点从邻居收集特征、聚合后更新自身 embedding。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Message passing is a GNN's core computation: a node collects features from neighbors, aggregates, and updates its embedding.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把多个邻居特征汇成一个向量的方式,如 mean-pool、LSTM、注意力加权。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An aggregation function combines many neighbor features into one vector, e.g. mean-pool, LSTM, or attention weighting.

scenario: 有用户购买历史(表格)加一张社交图,面试官问要不要为此上 GNN。
scenario_en: You have purchase history (tabular) plus a social graph; the interviewer asks whether to add a GNN.
q: 面对表格+图数据,正确的决策姿态是什么?
q_en: With tabular plus graph data, what's the right decision stance?
why: 先用表格基线跑出质量,再验证"加入多跳图信号是否可证明地提升质量";只有提升成立才上 GNN。直接因为有图就上,可能白背构图、采样、多跳 serving 的成本却没换来指标提升。
why_en: Run a tabular baseline first, then adopt a GNN only if multi-hop graph signal demonstrably improves quality beyond it.
options: 只要存在图结构就默认接入 GNN,省去与表格基线的效果对比
先跑表格基线,只有多跳图信号可证明地提升质量时才上 GNN
彻底不碰图信号,只要表格特征够多,模型就永远不需要图
先删掉图简化上线路径,等表格模型稳定后再评估要不要补图
options_en: If graph structure exists, default to adding a GNN and skip any comparison against a tabular baseline.
Run a tabular baseline first and adopt a GNN only if multi-hop graph signal demonstrably improves quality.
Skip graph signal entirely — as long as tabular features are rich enough, you'll never need a graph.
Delete the graph first to simplify the launch, then decide whether to add it back once the tabular model is stable.
whenOtherWins: 当离线实验显示多跳结构对目标(如识别 mule 账户的二跳模式)有明确增益时,GNN 的成本就值得付。
optionExplanations: 跳过与基线的效果对比、只因存在图结构就默认上 GNN,是把结论前置,可能白背构图和多跳 serving 成本却未必换来增益。
对;用基线做对照、以"可证明的提升"为门槛,是把成本和收益绑住的成熟做法。
以为表格特征足够丰富就能替代图信号,会漏掉真实的多跳结构(如欺诈环这类靠远距离关系才能捕捉的模式)。
先删图再上线、事后再补,同样是没拿基线量出图信号增益就先斩后奏,顺序对了但决策依据仍是拍脑袋。
optionExplanations_en: Skipping the baseline comparison and defaulting to a GNN just because a graph exists front-loads the conclusion, risking full GNN cost for no proven gain.
Correct — using a baseline as control with 'demonstrable improvement' as the gate ties cost to benefit maturely.
Assuming rich tabular features can substitute for graph signal misses real multi-hop structure, like fraud rings only visible through distant relations.
Deleting the graph first and reconsidering later is still a decision made without measuring the gain against a baseline — reordering doesn't fix that.

scenario: 面试官让你举 GNN 真正带来增益的典型场景。
scenario_en: The interviewer asks for canonical cases where a GNN truly adds value.
q: 以下哪些是 GNN 的经典适用场景?(多选)
q_en: Which are canonical GNN use cases? (multiple)
why: 都靠多跳关系:社交/好友推荐看二度连接和社群结构;欺诈检测靠 mule/ring 这类异常子图模式,单笔交易特征看不见;知识图谱补全预测缺失关系。共同点是答案藏在图结构里而非单节点特征。
why_en: All rely on multi-hop structure: connection recommendation, fraud subgraph patterns, and knowledge-graph completion.
options: 社交/好友推荐(二度连接、社群结构)
欺诈检测(mule/ring 账户的异常子图模式)
知识图谱补全(预测缺失关系)
单张图片的像素级分类
options_en: Social/connection recommendation (second-degree links, community structure).
Fraud detection (anomalous subgraph patterns like mule/ring accounts).
Knowledge-graph completion (predicting missing relations).
Pixel-level classification of a single image.
optionExplanations: 对;好友推荐靠二度连接和社群结构,是典型的多跳关系信号。
对;mule/ring 是跨账户的子图模式,单笔交易的表格特征根本看不见,GNN 才抓得到。
对;知识图谱补全就是在实体关系图上预测缺失边,天然是图任务。
错;单图像素分类是空间局部性问题,CNN 处理,和图关系结构无关。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — friend recommendation leans on second-degree links and community structure, classic multi-hop signal.
Correct — mule/ring are cross-account subgraph patterns invisible to per-transaction tabular features but caught by a GNN.
Correct — knowledge-graph completion predicts missing edges on an entity-relation graph, inherently a graph task.
Wrong — single-image pixel classification is a spatial-locality problem for CNNs, unrelated to graph structure.

termDefinitions.term: mule / ring account / 傀儡/环状账户
termDefinitions.meaning: 欺诈里用于中转或互相转账掩盖资金的账户群,呈现异常子图模式。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Mule/ring accounts are fraud account clusters used to relay or circulate funds, forming anomalous subgraph patterns.

termDefinitions.term: knowledge-graph completion / 知识图谱补全
termDefinitions.meaning: 在实体-关系图上预测缺失的边(关系)。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Knowledge-graph completion predicts missing edges (relations) in an entity-relation graph.

scenario: 社交图每天大量新用户加入,要求新节点无需重训就能立刻拿到 embedding,serving 成本还要可控。
scenario_en: A social graph gains many new users daily; new nodes must get embeddings without retraining, with bounded serving cost.
q: GraphSAGE 还是 GAT?
q_en: GraphSAGE or GAT?
why: 选 GraphSAGE:它 inductive,学聚合函数而非固定节点向量,新节点采样邻居即可算出 embedding、无需重训;固定 fan-out 让 serving 成本有界。
why_en: Pick GraphSAGE: it's inductive and learns an aggregation function, so new nodes embed at inference without retraining, and fixed fan-out bounds serving cost.
options: GAT,逐边注意力更精细,准确率一定更高,所以任何场景都该选它
GraphSAGE,inductive,新节点无需重训即可 embed
两个都不行,动态图只能每天做一次全量重训才能更新 embedding
GAT,因为它是 inductive 而 GraphSAGE 是 transductive
options_en: GAT — per-edge attention is finer and surely more accurate, so pick it in every scenario.
GraphSAGE — inductive, so new nodes embed without retraining.
Neither works; a dynamic graph forces a full retrain every day to refresh embeddings.
GAT — because it's inductive while GraphSAGE is transductive.
whenOtherWins: 当某些边的重要性差异极大、且延迟预算宽松(如一条可疑欺诈边远比其他边关键)时,GAT 的逐边注意力更值。
optionExplanations: GAT 更精细但加延迟,"任何场景都选"忽略了本题对新节点即时 embed 和 serving 成本的硬约束。
对;inductive+可采样固定 fan-out 正好命中"新节点免重训+成本有界",是动态图的生产默认。
动态图恰恰不用全量重训,GraphSAGE 的 inductive 能力就是为此设计的。
说反了:GraphSAGE 才是 inductive,能给未见过的新节点算 embedding。
optionExplanations_en: GAT is finer but adds latency; 'pick it always' ignores this task's hard constraints on instant new-node embedding and serving cost.
Correct — inductive plus fixed fan-out sampling hits 'new nodes without retraining and bounded cost', the production default for dynamic graphs.
Dynamic graphs specifically avoid full retraining; GraphSAGE's inductive ability is built for exactly this.
Reversed: GraphSAGE is the inductive one that can embed unseen new nodes.

termDefinitions.meaning: inductive GNN,采样固定大小邻域并学聚合函数,新节点推理即可 embed。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: GraphSAGE (Graph SAmple and aggreGatE) is an inductive GNN that samples a fixed neighborhood and learns an aggregation function, embedding new nodes at inference.

termDefinitions.meaning: 学的是通用聚合规则而非记住特定节点,能给训练时未见过的新节点算 embedding。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Inductive means learning a general aggregation rule rather than memorizing specific nodes, so unseen new nodes can be embedded.

tradeoff: 新节点即时可用+成本有界(GraphSAGE) vs 邻居加权更精细但加延迟(GAT)

scenario: 面试官问 GraphSAGE 为什么适合频繁新增节点的动态图。
scenario_en: The interviewer asks why GraphSAGE suits dynamic graphs with frequent new nodes.
q: GraphSAGE 的 inductive 特性具体带来什么?
q_en: What does GraphSAGE's inductive property concretely give you?
why: 它学的是"如何聚合邻居"这个函数,不是记住每个节点的固定向量。所以来了新节点,只要采样它的邻居、套用已学的聚合函数,推理时就能现算 embedding,不用把整个模型重训一遍。
why_en: GraphSAGE learns an aggregation function rather than fixed per-node vectors, so a new node's embedding is computed at inference by sampling its neighbors, no retraining.
options: 它为每个已知节点存一份固定向量表,新节点没有表项时就退化成随机初始化
它学聚合函数,新节点采样邻居后推理即可现算 embedding,无需重训
它把整张图预训练成一个静态 embedding,新节点会自动继承
它要求每加一个新节点就全量重训,以保证 embedding 最新
options_en: It stores a fixed vector per known node; a new node with no table entry falls back to random initialization.
It learns an aggregation function, so a new node's embedding is computed at inference after sampling neighbors, no retraining.
It pretrains the whole graph into one static embedding that new nodes inherit automatically.
It requires full retraining on every new node to keep embeddings fresh.
optionExplanations: 查表是 transductive 做法,新节点没有表项只能随机初始化,恰恰是 GraphSAGE 用聚合函数要绕开的问题。
对;学函数而非记向量,是 inductive 的核心,让未见节点也能即时 embed。
不存在"自动继承"的静态全图 embedding,新节点需要用聚合函数现算。
全量重训正是 inductive 要避免的,GraphSAGE 的价值就在于免重训。
optionExplanations_en: Lookup tables are the transductive approach; a new node with no entry falls back to random init — exactly what GraphSAGE's aggregation function avoids.
Correct — learning a function rather than memorizing vectors is the essence of inductive, embedding unseen nodes on the fly.
There's no auto-inherited static whole-graph embedding; a new node is computed on the fly via the aggregation function.
Full retraining is what inductive avoids; GraphSAGE's value is precisely no retraining.

scenario: 欺诈图里,一个节点的众多邻居中往往只有一条边(可疑往来)真正关键。
scenario_en: In a fraud graph, among a node's many neighbors often just one edge (a suspicious link) really matters.
q: GAT 相比 mean 聚合多做了什么?
q_en: What does GAT add over mean aggregation?
why: GAT 给每条边学一个注意力权重 α_ij(对邻居做 softmax 归一),再加权求和,而不是对所有邻居一视同仁取平均。这让它能聚焦最有信息量的连接——当某条边远比其他重要时(如可疑欺诈边)特别有用,代价是逐边算注意力增加延迟。
why_en: GAT learns a per-edge attention weight (softmax over neighbors) and does a weighted sum, focusing on the most informative edges at the cost of per-edge attention latency.
options: GAT 对所有邻居一律取平均,比 GraphSAGE 更简单也更快
GAT 给每条边学注意力权重,加权求和聚焦最关键的连接
GAT 随机丢弃一半邻居来加速,靠采样而非权重区分邻居
GAT 把邻居特征直接拼接不做任何聚合,信息保留得最全
options_en: GAT just averages all neighbors, simpler and faster than GraphSAGE.
GAT learns a per-edge attention weight and does a weighted sum focused on the key links.
GAT randomly drops half the neighbors to speed up, using sampling rather than weights.
GAT concatenates neighbor features with no aggregation, keeping the most information.
optionExplanations: 一视同仁取平均是 mean 聚合(GraphSAGE 常用),恰恰是 GAT 要改进的对象。
对;逐边注意力让重要连接权重更高,适合"少数边极关键"的场景,但每边算 α 加延迟。
随机丢邻居是采样策略,不是 GAT 的注意力机制,GAT 是加权不是丢弃。
直接拼接不聚合会让维度爆炸且丢失置换不变性,不是 GAT 做法。
optionExplanations_en: Uniform averaging is mean aggregation (GraphSAGE's common choice), exactly what GAT improves on.
Correct — per-edge attention up-weights important links, suited to 'a few edges dominate', but computing alpha per edge adds latency.
Randomly dropping neighbors is a sampling strategy, not GAT's attention; GAT weights rather than drops.
Concatenating without aggregation explodes dimensionality and loses permutation invariance — not GAT.

termDefinitions.meaning: 为每条边学注意力权重、加权聚合邻居的 GNN,聚焦最有信息量的连接。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: GAT (Graph Attention Network) learns a per-edge attention weight and aggregates neighbors by weighted sum, focusing on the most informative links.

termDefinitions.term: attention weight α_ij / 注意力权重
termDefinitions.meaning: 节点 i 对邻居 j 的重要度,经邻居 softmax 归一后用于加权聚合。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The attention weight alpha_ij is how much node i weights neighbor j, softmax-normalized over neighbors for weighted aggregation.

scenario: 面试官要你在一个维度上对比 GraphSAGE 和 GAT,帮助选型。
scenario_en: The interviewer asks you to contrast GraphSAGE and GAT on one axis to guide selection.
q: GraphSAGE 与 GAT 的核心取舍轴是什么?
q_en: What's the core trade-off axis between GraphSAGE and GAT?
why: 取舍轴是"扩展简单 vs 邻居加权精细":GraphSAGE+mean 聚合更便宜更好扩,把每个邻居等价对待;GAT 逐边注意力能区分邻居重要性、更精细,但每条边算 α 增加延迟。高吞吐/大图偏 GraphSAGE,少数边极关键偏 GAT。
why_en: The axis is cheap scalability versus fine neighbor weighting: GraphSAGE+mean scales cheaply, GAT's per-edge attention is finer but adds latency.

rows: 每边算 α 加延迟

options: 扩展便宜(GraphSAGE) vs 加权精细加延迟(GAT)
GAT 永远更快更省,GraphSAGE 永远更慢,两者之间没有任何取舍
两者完全等价,选哪个只取决于团队用的代码库支持哪个
GraphSAGE 做精细加权、GAT 做等价平均,和实际情况正好相反
options_en: Cheap scaling (GraphSAGE) versus finer weighting with added latency (GAT).
GAT is always faster and cheaper while GraphSAGE is always slower, with no trade-off at all.
They're fully equivalent; the choice depends only on which library your team already uses.
GraphSAGE does fine weighting and GAT does uniform averaging — the reverse of reality.
optionExplanations: 对;一句点名取舍轴——扩展成本 vs 邻居加权精细度,选型就在这条轴上权衡。
GAT 的逐边注意力更贵不是更省,"永远更快"与机制矛盾。
两者在邻居加权和扩展成本上有实质差异,不是等价。
角色说反了:GAT 才做逐边注意力加权,GraphSAGE 常用 mean 等价聚合。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — one line names the axis: scaling cost versus neighbor-weighting granularity, where selection is decided.
GAT's per-edge attention is costlier not cheaper; 'always faster' contradicts the mechanism.
They differ materially in neighbor weighting and scaling cost, so not equivalent.
Roles reversed: GAT does per-edge attention weighting; GraphSAGE typically uses uniform mean aggregation.

scenario: 有人想把 GNN 堆到 8–10 层以捕捉更远的关系,结果所有节点 embedding 变得几乎一样。
scenario_en: Someone stacks a GNN to 8-10 layers for longer-range relations, and all node embeddings become nearly identical.
q: 为什么 GNN 通常只用 2–3 层?
q_en: Why do GNNs usually use only 2-3 layers?
why: 层数太多会 over-smoothing:每层都把邻居信息混进来,堆多层后每个节点的感受野几乎覆盖全图,embedding 相互趋同、失去区分度。所以实践限制在 2–3 层,靠采样/注意力在有限跳内取信号。
why_en: Too many layers cause over-smoothing: repeated neighbor mixing makes every node's receptive field span the graph and embeddings converge, so 2-3 layers is the practical cap.
options: 因为超过 3 层就无法反向传播,梯度算不出来,模型根本训不动
因为层数多会 over-smoothing,节点表示趋同
因为 2–3 层是硬件规定的上限,GPU 显存再大也装不下更多层
因为层数越多准确率越高,只是为了省算力成本才限制在 2–3 层
options_en: Because beyond 3 layers backprop breaks, gradients can't be computed, and training stalls.
Because more layers cause over-smoothing and node representations converge.
Because 2-3 layers is a hardware-imposed cap; no amount of GPU memory holds more.
Because more layers always mean higher accuracy, capped at 2-3 only to save compute cost.
optionExplanations: 深层网络照样能反向传播,GNN 层数限制不是梯度算不出来的问题。
对;over-smoothing 让感受野过大、节点表示同质化,这才是限层数的根因。
不是硬件上限,是表达退化的算法问题,加显存也解决不了 over-smoothing。
恰恰相反,超过 2–3 层通常掉点,不是省钱而是效果变差。
optionExplanations_en: Deep nets still backprop fine; the GNN depth limit isn't about gradients being uncomputable.
Correct — over-smoothing enlarges the receptive field until node representations homogenize, the real reason to cap depth.
Not a hardware cap but an expressiveness degradation; more memory won't fix over-smoothing.
The opposite: beyond 2-3 layers accuracy usually drops; it's degradation, not cost saving.

termDefinitions.meaning: 层数过多时反复混合邻居,使所有节点 embedding 趋同、失去区分度。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Over-smoothing is when too many layers repeatedly mix neighbors until all node embeddings converge and lose distinctiveness.

scenario: 2 层 GNN、每跳采样 15 个邻居,一个目标节点要拉进约 225 个节点;3 层就到约 3,375 个。
scenario_en: A 2-layer GNN sampling 15 neighbors/hop pulls in ~225 nodes per target; 3 layers reaches ~3,375.
q: 这组数字揭示 GNN 的什么核心成本,怎么用它做设计?
q_en: What core GNN cost does this reveal, and how do you use it in design?
why: 计算图随深度指数增长:每加一跳节点数乘以 fan-out(15²≈225,15³≈3,375),即邻域爆炸。所以要限层数 2–3、控 fan-out,防 batch OOM。
why_en: The computation graph grows exponentially with depth (15^2≈225, 15^3≈3,375), which is neighborhood explosion, so cap depth and fan-out to keep batches from OOM.
options: 说明节点越多训练越快,应该尽量加深层数来拉进更多邻居节点
计算图随深度指数增长(邻域爆炸),要靠限层数+采样压住
225 和 3,375 是框架写死的固定常数,与 fan-out 和层数无关
说明 GNN 内存占用与图规模无关,可以无限水平扩展
options_en: It shows more nodes means faster training, so deepen layers to pull in more neighbors.
The computation graph grows exponentially with depth (neighborhood explosion); cap depth and sample.
225 and 3,375 are constants hard-coded by the framework, unrelated to fan-out and depth.
It shows GNN memory is independent of graph size and scales horizontally without limit.
optionExplanations: 拉更多节点只会更慢更吃内存,加深层数正是引爆 explosion 的原因。
对;指数增长是 GNN 独有的成本,数字直接约束 batch 大小,靠限层+采样才能训得动。
225=15²、3,375=15³,明明是 fan-out 和层数的函数,不是常数。
内存恰恰随采样计算图指数增长,不能无限扩,这正是要采样的原因。
optionExplanations_en: Pulling more nodes is slower and memory-hungrier; deepening layers is exactly what detonates the explosion.
Correct — exponential growth is a GNN-specific cost; the numbers cap batch size, and depth limits plus sampling make it trainable.
225=15^2 and 3,375=15^3 are functions of fan-out and depth, not constants.
Memory grows exponentially with the sampled computation graph, so it can't scale infinitely — the reason to sample.

termDefinitions.meaning: GNN 计算图随层数指数增长,节点数按 fan-out 的幂次膨胀。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Neighborhood explosion is the GNN computation graph growing exponentially with depth, node count expanding as a power of fan-out.

termDefinitions.meaning: 每一跳采样的邻居数量,如 hop1 采 10、hop2 采 5。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Fan-out is the number of neighbors sampled per hop, e.g. 10 at hop1 and 5 at hop2.

scenario: 同样的 FLOPs 下,GNN 训练比稠密网络慢 2–5 倍,GPU 利用率上不去。
scenario_en: At equal FLOPs, GNN training runs 2-5x slower than dense networks and GPU utilization stays low.
q: GNN 这种"算力没跑满还更慢"的根因是什么?
q_en: Why is a GNN slower with GPU underutilized despite equal FLOPs?
why: 图拓扑稀疏不规则,邻居在内存里散落,访存非连续、无法合并读取,GPU 大量时间在等数据而非算数。这就是 GNN 特有的 irregular memory access 瓶颈。
why_en: Sparse, irregular graph topology forces non-sequential memory reads, so the GPU stalls waiting on scattered data rather than computing, causing 2-5x slowdown at equal FLOPs.
options: 因为 GNN 参数量比稠密网络大得多,纯粹是要算的乘加更多
因为稀疏不规则拓扑导致非连续访存,GPU 在等数据而非算数
因为 GNN 只能跑在 CPU 上,框架不支持 GPU 加速
因为图数据必须每一步都落盘读写,磁盘 I/O 才是真瓶颈
options_en: Because GNNs have far more parameters than dense nets; it's simply more multiply-adds.
Because sparse, irregular topology causes non-sequential access, so the GPU waits on data.
Because GNNs run only on CPU and the frameworks don't support GPU acceleration.
Because graph data must be read and written to disk every step, so disk I/O is the real bottleneck.
optionExplanations: 题目明说"同 FLOPs",所以不是算得更多,而是访存效率低。
对;不规则稀疏访存让 GPU 频繁 stall,合并读取失效,这是 GNN 独有的慢因。
GNN 完全能用 GPU,只是访存不规则导致利用率低,不是不支持。
瓶颈在显存的随机访问模式,不是磁盘 I/O,数据通常已在显存里。
optionExplanations_en: The task states equal FLOPs, so it's not more compute but poor memory-access efficiency.
Correct — irregular sparse access makes the GPU stall and defeats coalesced reads, a GNN-specific slowdown.
GNNs run fine on GPU; irregular access just lowers utilization — not a lack of support.
The bottleneck is random access in device memory, not disk I/O; data is usually already resident.

termDefinitions.term: irregular memory access / 不规则访存
termDefinitions.meaning: 稀疏图拓扑使邻居在内存中散落,读取非连续,GPU 无法合并访存而利用率低。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Irregular memory access is when sparse graph topology scatters neighbors in memory, so reads are non-sequential and the GPU can't coalesce them.

scenario: 实时打分要求 <50ms,但 GNN 推理要从分布式图存储里逐跳拉取邻居,网络 I/O 叠加起来很难达标。
scenario_en: Real-time scoring needs <50ms, but GNN inference fetches neighbors hop by hop from a distributed graph store, stacking network I/O.
q: GNN 实时推理为什么难达标,主流解法是什么?
q_en: Why is GNN real-time inference hard to hit, and what's the main fix?
why: 多跳推理要跨机反复拉邻居,每跳叠加网络 I/O,900M+ 节点规模下 <50ms 几乎不可能。解法是把 embedding 提前算好放进特征库,线上只做一次读取。
why_en: Multi-hop inference repeatedly fetches neighbors across machines, stacking network I/O, so the main fix is precomputing embeddings offline into a feature store and serving a lookup.
options: 把 GNN 换成参数量更大的模型,算得更准就能达标
离线预算 embedding 存特征库,线上退化为查表
给每个请求开更多线程并行拉取邻居,就一定能压到 50ms 内
把 <50ms 的要求放宽到几秒,是唯一可行的办法
options_en: Swap the GNN for a model with more parameters; higher accuracy meets the budget.
Precompute embeddings into a feature store and degrade online serving to a lookup.
Spin up more threads per request to parallelize neighbor fetching and always get under 50ms.
Relaxing the <50ms requirement to a few seconds is the only workable option.
optionExplanations: 换大模型只会更慢,和多跳拉取的 I/O 瓶颈无关,方向错。
对;离线预算 embedding、把 GNN 变成特征生成管线,是绕开实时多跳延迟最有效的解法。
多线程摊薄不了跨机多跳的固有 I/O 叠加,大图上仍难稳定 <50ms。
放宽 SLA 是逃避,离线预算才能既满足 <50ms 又保留图信号。
optionExplanations_en: A bigger model is only slower and unrelated to the multi-hop fetch I/O bottleneck — wrong direction.
Correct — precomputing embeddings turns the GNN into a feature-generation pipeline, the most effective way to dodge real-time multi-hop latency.
More threads can't amortize the inherent cross-machine multi-hop I/O stacking; large graphs still miss <50ms.
Relaxing the SLA is evasion; precomputation meets <50ms while keeping the graph signal.

termDefinitions.term: distributed graph store / 分布式图存储
termDefinitions.meaning: 把大图分片存在多台机器上的存储,取多跳邻居要跨机读取。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A distributed graph store shards a large graph across machines, so fetching multi-hop neighbors requires cross-machine reads.

scenario: 面试官让你主动点名 GNN 相比普通深度模型独有的扩展性瓶颈。
scenario_en: The interviewer asks you to proactively name GNN-specific scalability bottlenecks versus ordinary deep models.
q: 以下哪些是 GNN 独有的扩展性瓶颈?(多选)
q_en: Which are GNN-specific scalability bottlenecks? (multiple)
why: 三个独有瓶颈:邻域爆炸(计算图随深度指数增长→OOM)、不规则访存(稀疏拓扑→GPU 慢 2–5 倍)、推理延迟(多跳跨机拉取→难 <50ms)。主动点名这三个,直接向面试官证明你懂真实工程约束。
why_en: The three GNN-specific bottlenecks are neighborhood explosion, irregular memory access, and multi-hop inference latency.
options: 邻域爆炸:计算图随深度指数增长,导致 OOM、限制 batch
不规则访存:稀疏拓扑非连续读,GPU 利用率低、慢 2–5 倍
推理延迟:多跳跨机拉邻居叠加网络 I/O,难满足 <50ms
梯度消失:必须靠残差连接才能训练
options_en: Neighborhood explosion: computation graph grows exponentially with depth, causing OOM and limiting batch.
Irregular memory access: sparse topology's non-sequential reads underuse the GPU, 2-5x slower.
Inference latency: multi-hop cross-machine neighbor fetches stack network I/O, hard to meet <50ms.
Vanishing gradients: must use residual connections to train.
optionExplanations: 对;邻域爆炸是深度指数增长的独有成本,直接限制 batch 并可能 OOM。
对;稀疏图的非连续访存让 GPU 空等,同 FLOPs 慢 2–5 倍,是 GNN 特有瓶颈。
对;多跳跨机拉取叠加 I/O,是 GNN 实时 serving 最难的一环。
错;梯度消失是深层 CNN/ResNet 的问题,GNN 只用 2–3 层,不是它的独有瓶颈。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — neighborhood explosion is the depth-exponential cost unique here, capping batch and risking OOM.
Correct — sparse non-sequential access stalls the GPU, 2-5x slower at equal FLOPs, a GNN-specific bottleneck.
Correct — multi-hop cross-machine fetches stacking I/O are the hardest part of real-time GNN serving.
Wrong — vanishing gradients afflict deep CNN/ResNet; GNNs use only 2-3 layers, so it's not their bottleneck.

scenario: 面对邻域爆炸,生产上有三种采样思路可选。
scenario_en: Against neighborhood explosion, production offers three sampling approaches.
q: node-wise / layer-wise / subgraph 采样各自怎么砍计算量?
q_en: How do node-wise / layer-wise / subgraph sampling each cut compute?
why: 三者采样单位不同:node-wise 按节点每跳采固定邻居;layer-wise 每层跨 batch 采共享节点集;subgraph 抽独立小子图训练。
why_en: Node-wise samples fixed neighbors per node, layer-wise samples a fixed node set per layer across the batch to cut redundant compute, and subgraph trains on a small self-contained subgraph.

rows: 每层跨 batch 固定节点集

options: 三者本质一样,只是名字不同,采样效果和内存占用没有区别
采样单位分别是每节点邻居、每层跨 batch 节点集、整块子图
node-wise 抽子图、subgraph 每节点采邻居,和实际正好相反
三种都要求先加载全图再采样,所以都无法降低内存占用
options_en: All three are essentially the same, just different names, with identical effect and memory use.
The sampling units are per-node neighbors, a per-layer node set across the batch, and a whole subgraph.
Node-wise extracts subgraphs and subgraph samples neighbors per node — the reverse of reality.
All three must load the full graph before sampling, so none of them reduces memory.
optionExplanations: 三者采样单位不同(节点/层/子图),省算量的机制和适用场景也不同,不是一回事。
对;三种采样单位不同——按节点、按层、按子图,分别对应不同的冗余削减方式。
名字对应说反了:node-wise 是按节点采邻居,subgraph 才是抽子图。
采样正是为了不看全图,ClusterGCN 抽小子图就能独立训练降内存。
optionExplanations_en: The three differ in sampling unit (node/layer/subgraph), with different redundancy-cutting mechanisms and use cases.
Correct — the sampling units differ (per node, per layer, per subgraph), each cutting redundancy differently.
The mapping is reversed: node-wise samples neighbors per node; subgraph is the one extracting subgraphs.
Sampling exists precisely to avoid the full graph; ClusterGCN's small subgraph trains independently and cuts memory.

termDefinitions.meaning: layer-wise 采样的 GNN,每层跨 batch 采固定节点集,削减目标间的重复计算。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: FastGCN uses layer-wise sampling, drawing a fixed node set per layer across the batch to cut redundant compute among targets.

termDefinitions.meaning: subgraph 采样的 GNN,抽一个自成一体的小子图当独立训练单元。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: ClusterGCN uses subgraph sampling, extracting a small self-contained subgraph as an independent training unit.

tradeoff: 采样粒度(节点/层/子图) vs 精度损失与实现复杂度

scenario: 一个 batch 里很多目标节点彼此靠近、共享大量邻居,node-wise 采样反复重算这些共享邻居很浪费。
scenario_en: In a batch many target nodes are close and share neighbors, and node-wise sampling wastefully recomputes those shared neighbors.
q: 该换哪种采样策略?
q_en: Which sampling strategy should you switch to?
why: 选 layer-wise(FastGCN):它每层跨整个 batch 采一个共享的固定节点集,同一批目标共用这些节点的计算,正好消掉 node-wise 里重复算共享邻居的浪费。node-wise 适合邻居重叠少的场景。
why_en: Pick layer-wise (FastGCN): it samples one shared node set per layer across the batch, eliminating node-wise's redundant recomputation of shared neighbors.
options: 继续 node-wise,再把每跳邻居数调大就不浪费了
layer-wise(FastGCN),每层跨 batch 采共享节点集
改成不采样、每次跑全图,保证信息最全
subgraph(ClusterGCN),因为它每个目标各自抽一个独立子图互不共享
options_en: Stay node-wise and just raise neighbors per hop to stop the waste.
Layer-wise (FastGCN): sample one shared node set per layer across the batch.
Switch to no sampling and run the full graph each time for maximum information.
Subgraph (ClusterGCN), because each target extracts its own independent subgraph with no sharing.
whenOtherWins: 当目标节点分散、几乎不共享邻居时,layer-wise 的共享采样优势消失,node-wise 或 subgraph 反而更合适。
optionExplanations: 调大邻居数只会加重重复计算,浪费更多,方向反了。
对;layer-wise 跨 batch 共享采样节点,目标间的共享邻居只算一次,正好治重复计算。
不采样跑全图会引爆邻域爆炸,OOM 且更慢,不是解决重复的办法。
ClusterGCN 是抽整块子图,不是"每目标各自独立子图",这里要的是共享而非隔离。
optionExplanations_en: Raising neighbor counts worsens redundant compute and wastes more — wrong direction.
Correct — layer-wise shares sampled nodes across the batch so shared neighbors are computed once, curing the redundancy.
Full-graph without sampling detonates neighborhood explosion, causing OOM and more slowdown — not a fix for redundancy.
ClusterGCN extracts a whole cluster subgraph, not per-target independent subgraphs; here you want sharing, not isolation.
tradeoff: 跨目标共享计算(layer-wise) vs 每目标独立采样更可控(node-wise)

scenario: 图有数十亿条边,单机显存放不下,要在多机上分布式训练但又怕跨机通信拖垮吞吐。
scenario_en: A graph has billions of edges too big for one machine's memory; you distribute training but fear cross-machine comms killing throughput.
q: 内存瓶颈下,分布式训练的关键设计是什么?
q_en: Under the memory bottleneck, what's the key distributed-training design?
why: 做图分区(graph partitioning):把图切到多机、最小化跨分区的边,让大部分消息传递在本机完成;跨分区通信批量化并与计算重叠,异步预取数据让 GPU 不停等。分区质量直接决定训练吞吐。
why_en: Partition the graph across machines minimizing cross-partition edges so most message passing stays local, batching and overlapping cross-partition comms with async prefetch.
options: 随机把节点均匀分到各台机器,简单而且负载最均衡
图分区:最小化跨分区边,让消息传递多在本地完成
把整张图完整复制到每台机器上,彻底避免跨机通信
只保留高度数节点、丢弃其余,把图缩小到单机放得下
options_en: Randomly split nodes evenly across machines — simple and best load-balanced.
Graph partitioning: minimize cross-partition edges so message passing stays local.
Replicate the whole graph on every machine to avoid any cross-machine communication.
Keep only high-degree nodes and drop the rest to shrink the graph onto one machine.
whenOtherWins: 若图本身能整块放进单机显存,就不必分区,直接单机训练更简单、没有跨机通信开销。
optionExplanations: 随机分区会切断大量边,跨机通信暴涨,负载均衡也换不回被通信吃掉的吞吐。
对;最小化割边让消息传递多在本地,再靠批量+重叠+异步预取藏住剩余通信,吞吐才稳。
全图复制到每台机内存放不下(数十亿边),正是内存瓶颈要解决的问题,复制无解。
丢弃节点会破坏图结构、丢失多跳信号,是损害模型质量的错误简化。
optionExplanations_en: Random partitioning cuts many edges, exploding cross-machine comms; balance can't win back throughput lost to comms.
Correct — minimizing cut edges keeps message passing local, and batching, overlap, and async prefetch hide the rest, stabilizing throughput.
Replicating the whole graph won't fit in each machine's memory (billions of edges) — the very memory bottleneck at hand.
Dropping nodes breaks graph structure and loses multi-hop signal, a harmful over-simplification.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把大图切分到多台机器,尽量减少跨分区的边以降低跨机通信。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Graph partitioning splits a large graph across machines, minimizing cross-partition edges to reduce cross-machine communication.

tradeoff: 本地消息传递省跨机通信 vs 分区计算与负载不均的代价

scenario: 推荐/排序系统用 GNN,图变化不快(如社交连接),但线上打分有严格延迟预算。
scenario_en: A rec/ranking system uses a GNN on a slowly changing graph (social links) but has a strict online-scoring latency budget.
q: 延迟约束下,最有效的 serving 策略是什么?
q_en: Under the latency constraint, what's the most effective serving strategy?
why: 离线批量算好所有节点 embedding,存进特征库,线上把 GNN 退化成一次特征查表——最有效的降延迟手段,把 GNN 变成特征生成管线。图变化慢时定期刷新即可;代价是 embedding 有一定 staleness。
why_en: Precompute all node embeddings offline into a feature store and serve them as lookup features, turning the GNN into a feature-generation pipeline with periodic refresh.
diagram:
flowchart LR
  G["离线跑 GNN"] --> E["节点 embedding"]
  E --> F["特征库"]
  F --> S["线上查表打分"]
options: 每次请求实时跑完整多跳 GNN,保证 embedding 绝对最新
离线批量算好 embedding 存特征库,线上退化为查表
把 GNN 层数加到 8 层以提高准确率,延迟以后再优化
只在客户端跑 GNN,服务器完全不参与打分
options_en: Run the full multi-hop GNN live per request to keep embeddings perfectly fresh.
Precompute embeddings offline into a feature store and serve a lookup online.
Deepen the GNN to 8 layers for accuracy and optimize latency later.
Run the GNN only on the client, with the server not scoring at all.
whenOtherWins: 当图变化极快(如实时欺诈图),预算好的 embedding 会过时,这时才需要实时推理(配合缓存热点邻域+限深 2 层)。
optionExplanations: 实时跑多跳 GNN 正是延迟瓶颈本身,严格预算下扛不住。
对;图变化慢时离线预算 embedding 把推理挪出实时路径,是最有效的降延迟手段。
加深层数会 over-smoothing 且更慢,和降延迟目标相悖。
端上跑多跳 GNN 受设备算力和本地图数据限制,不现实。
optionExplanations_en: Running the multi-hop GNN live is the latency bottleneck itself, untenable under a strict budget.
Correct — on a slow graph, precomputing embeddings moves inference off the hot path, the most effective latency fix.
Deepening layers causes over-smoothing and more latency, contradicting the goal.
Running a multi-hop GNN on the client is limited by device compute and local graph data — impractical.

termDefinitions.meaning: 离线把结果算好存起来,线上直接查,把重计算挪出实时路径。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Precomputation computes results offline and stores them for online lookup, moving heavy work off the hot path.

termDefinitions.meaning: 预计算结果与当前真实状态之间的时间差,刷新周期越长越陈旧。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Staleness is the lag between precomputed results and current reality, worse with longer refresh intervals.

scenario: 实时欺诈检测,图变化极快(新账户/新交易秒级产生),离线预算好的 embedding 很快过时。
scenario_en: Real-time fraud detection on a fast-changing graph (new accounts/transactions every second), where precomputed embeddings go stale fast.
q: 这种必须实时的场景怎么控住延迟?
q_en: How do you control latency when real-time is unavoidable?
why: 缓存热点节点的邻域,并把深度严格限制在 2 层——两招都在砍每次实时推理要拉取和计算的邻居量,把多跳 fetch 压到能满足 <50ms。这是接受实时不可避免后的现实折中,而非首选。
why_en: Cache hot-node neighborhoods and strictly cap depth at 2 layers, both shrinking the neighbors fetched and computed per real-time inference.
options: 坚持离线预算 embedding,反正过时一点也能用
缓存热点节点邻域 + 严格限深 2 层
把图存到更慢但更大的冷存储里,腾出内存给模型
取消延迟要求,让欺诈判定慢慢跑几秒也没关系
options_en: Stick with precomputed embeddings; a bit stale is still usable.
Cache hot-node neighborhoods and strictly cap depth at 2 layers.
Move the graph to slower, larger cold storage to free memory for the model.
Drop the latency requirement and let fraud decisions take a few seconds.
whenOtherWins: 当图变化慢、可容忍分钟级 staleness 时,离线预算 embedding 才是更省的默认解,不必实时。
optionExplanations: 欺诈图秒级变化,过时 embedding 会漏掉刚出现的欺诈模式,这里不能容忍 staleness。
对;缓存热邻域+限深把实时多跳砍到可控,是必须实时时压延迟的现实折中。
换冷存储只会让拉邻居更慢,与 <50ms 目标背道而驰。
欺诈判定必须实时拦截,几秒延迟意味着钱已经被转走,不能取消要求。
optionExplanations_en: A fraud graph changes by the second, so stale embeddings miss just-emerged patterns — staleness is intolerable here.
Correct — caching hot neighborhoods and capping depth shrinks real-time multi-hop to a controllable size, the realistic latency compromise.
Cold storage only makes neighbor fetches slower, working against the <50ms goal.
Fraud must be blocked in real time; a few seconds means the money is already gone, so you can't drop the requirement.

termDefinitions.term: hot-node neighborhood cache / 热点邻域缓存
termDefinitions.meaning: 把高频访问节点的邻居预先缓存,减少实时推理时的跨机拉取。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A hot-node neighborhood cache pre-stores frequently accessed nodes' neighbors to cut cross-machine fetches at inference.

tradeoff: 实时新鲜度(实时推理) vs 延迟与成本(离线预算 embedding)

scenario: 面试里被问"要不要用 GNN",按一个可复用的 4 步框架回答最稳。
scenario_en: Asked 'should you use a GNN' in an interview, a reusable 4-step framework is the safest answer.
q: 把 GNN 决策的 4 步顺序排好:
q_en: Order the 4-step GNN decision sequence:
steps: 选并论证架构:GraphSAGE(inductive/可扩/常新节点) or GAT(邻居重要性差异大且延迟允许)
确认图信号超过表格基线,并举具体例子(二跳交易模式暴露 mule 账户)
标注缓解手段:采样 fan-out、限深 2 层、图分区、embedding 维度
显式说明 serving 模式:推荐/排序离线预算,只有快变图才实时
why: 先确认图信号值得(否则别上),再选并论证架构,接着定 serving 模式(离线预算 vs 实时),最后标注采样/限深/分区等缓解。按这个顺序答,把"是否用、用什么、怎么服务、怎么扛成本"一次讲透。
why_en: First confirm the graph signal beats tabular, then choose and justify the architecture, state the serving pattern, and finally annotate the mitigations.

termDefinitions.meaning: 线上如何提供 GNN 结果:离线预算 embedding 查表,还是实时多跳推理。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The serving pattern is how GNN results are delivered online: precomputed embedding lookup or real-time multi-hop inference.

scenario: LinkedIn 用 GraphSAGE,把 fan-out 调成 hop1 采 10 个、hop2 采 5 个邻居。
scenario_en: LinkedIn uses GraphSAGE with fan-out tuned to 10 neighbors at hop1 and 5 at hop2.
q: 这个 fan-out 配置在设计上起什么作用?
q_en: What does this fan-out configuration accomplish by design?
why: fan-out 直接决定计算图大小:10×5=50 个 hop2 邻居,加 10 个 hop1,单目标约几十个节点,把 serving 成本钉成有界常数、防邻域爆炸。近跳采多、远跳采少,因为近邻信息量更大、远邻边际收益递减。
why_en: Fan-out fixes the computation-graph size (10 then 5 gives tens of nodes per target), bounding serving cost and preventing neighborhood explosion.
options: 它决定模型有多少层,10 和 5 就是两层的层数配置
它把每目标的计算图钉成有界大小,防邻域爆炸
它设定学习率,10 和 5 是训练两个阶段的 lr
它是准确率指标,数值越大代表模型预测越准
options_en: It sets how many layers the model has; 10 and 5 are the two layer counts.
It bounds each target's computation graph, preventing neighborhood explosion.
It sets the learning rate; 10 and 5 are the LRs for two training stages.
It's an accuracy metric where a larger value means more accurate predictions.
optionExplanations: 层数是 hop 数(这里 2 层),fan-out 是每跳采几个邻居,两者不是一回事。
对;fan-out 把计算图大小固定,是让 serving 成本可预测、不爆炸的关键旋钮。
10/5 是采样邻居数不是学习率,和优化器超参无关。
fan-out 是成本/覆盖旋钮不是准确率,采太多反而更慢还可能引噪。
optionExplanations_en: Layers are hop count (2 here); fan-out is neighbors sampled per hop — different things.
Correct — fan-out fixes the computation-graph size, the key knob making serving cost predictable and non-exploding.
10/5 are sampled neighbor counts, not learning rates, unrelated to optimizer hyperparameters.
Fan-out is a cost/coverage knob, not accuracy; sampling too many is slower and can add noise.

scenario: 面试官评价:GNN 答案里有一句话往往是信号最高的。
scenario_en: The interviewer notes one sentence is usually the highest-signal line in a GNN answer.
q: GNN 答案里信号最高的一句通常是什么?
q_en: What's usually the highest-signal sentence in a GNN answer?
why: "我们离线预算节点 embedding,从特征库里以查表方式服务"——它一句话证明你懂 GNN 的真正瓶颈是实时多跳延迟,并给出把 GNN 变成特征生成管线的标准解法,直接体现工程成熟度。
why_en: 'We precompute node embeddings offline and serve them as lookups from a feature store' shows you grasp the real latency bottleneck and its standard fix.
options: "我们把层数堆到 10 层来捕捉更远的关系"
"我们离线预算节点 embedding,从特征库以查表方式服务"
"我们复现了最新论文里的 GNN 架构,离线准确率业界第一"
"我们每个请求都实时跑完整多跳推理保证最新"
options_en: 'We stack 10 layers to capture longer-range relations.'
'We precompute node embeddings offline and serve them as lookups from a feature store.'
'We reproduced the latest paper's GNN architecture, offline accuracy is top in the industry.'
'We run full multi-hop inference live per request to stay fresh.'
optionExplanations: 堆 10 层会 over-smoothing,暴露你不懂 GNN 的深度限制,是负信号。
对;这句点中 GNN 的服务瓶颈和标准解法,一句话显出工程成熟度。
复现论文架构、刷离线准确率,却不谈 serving 延迟等工程约束,是知识展示不是系统设计能力。
实时全跑多跳正是延迟瓶颈本身,说明你没意识到 serving 成本。
optionExplanations_en: Stacking 10 layers over-smooths and reveals you miss the depth limit — a negative signal.
Correct — it nails the serving bottleneck and standard fix, showing engineering maturity in one line.
Reproducing a paper's architecture and citing offline accuracy without engineering constraints like serving latency is knowledge display, not design skill.
Running full multi-hop live is the latency bottleneck itself, showing unawareness of serving cost.
